rules: Template instances are independent of later template edits.
Never copy fixed dates, completion states, old files or evidence into new work items.
Progress belongs in comments; template fields guide initial goal and acceptance.
Recommended people are suggestions, not access restrictions or automatic assignment.
Parent/subtask examples are not counted as distinct projects.
No reported benefit numbers are invented.
design_rules: Four-row, two-column native editor tables by default; decision template has three rows.
Hints are optional guidance, not required form fields.
Completion condition is a short part of description; do not add a separate acceptance report.
Keep owner/state/priority/dates in native properties; subtasks carry actual work division.
Use native links and attachments; show selected evidence in description and record ongoing progress in comments.
No prefilled person/date/status/evidence from reference work items.
Shared templates with member recommendations; no private copies.
Weekly reporting belongs in a project Page linking actual tasks, not a duplicated weekly task list.

member_guidance.包菲凡: 推荐资料与流程交付；根据机型文档、SOP或规范调整对象与依据提示。
member_guidance.曹燕: 推荐工具与系统交付；描述中重点写输入、业务规则和结果核对。
member_guidance.赖星宇: 推荐工具与系统交付；描述中重点写关键使用流程与上线可用条件。
member_guidance.金罗军: 推荐待决策事项；周会使用页面引用任务和成果，不重复维护状态。

weekly_page_outline.label: 本周成果
weekly_page_outline.hint: 选择重要结果，链接对应任务与证据。

weekly_page_outline.label: 下阶段重点

weekly_page_outline.label: 风险与决策
weekly_page_outline.hint: 有事项时写影响和需要的决定；未评估时明确说明。

review_summary.project_manager: Reduce duplication and use native task fields.
review_summary.product_manager: Merge similar templates and preserve visible outcomes from user example.
review_summary.development_manager: Keep input/rule or user-flow differences as hints inside one shared tool/system template.
review_summary.test_manager: Distinguish planned completion conditions from actual evidence; do not force acceptance checklists.
